delete-body: It is removed from the event. People who were told keep their notification.
dialog-body: Everyone going, maybe or on the waitlist is told. It stays on the event.
error-bad-date: That date is no longer on the calendar. Pick another.
error-canceled: This event was canceled, so it cannot get updates.
error-delete: That update can no longer be deleted.
error-forbidden: Only the host or a co-host can post updates.
error-rate-limited: An event can have 3 updates a day. The next one can be posted {{when}}.
error-rate-limited-soon: An event can have 3 updates a day. Try again later.
title: Updates
